name: Whole Brain Coverage
description: ASL should have whole-brain coverage (typically >100mm in z-direction). (From the ASL Clinical Guidelines schema.)
implementation:
slice_thickness = value["SliceThickness"].iloc[0]
num_slices = value["Count"].iloc[0]
coverage = slice_thickness * num_slices

if coverage < 100:
    raise ValidationWarning(f"Brain coverage ({coverage:.0f} mm) may be insufficient for whole-brain ASL. Consider increasing number of slices.")
